scope: Post-reboot re-verification that the vendor NVRAM source was never written by this work, plus the baseline build of the committed tree. Read-only device access.

device.note: the unit was rebooted by the operator before this check, so the vendor stack ran and updated its own runtime NVRAM

source_recheck.method: per-file sha256 of the four source trees on the device compared against the frozen private snapshot; two independent implementations (md-nvram-recheck.py and a fresh md-nvram-extract.py snapshot) agree
source_recheck.attribution: every device mtime is later than the snapshot mtimes (the latest snapshot mtime is 2026-11-17 10:20), so the deltas are writes performed by the vendor stack during the Android boots that happened after extraction; nine of them keep their exact size, which is consistent with in-place counter updates
source_recheck.our_writes: none: every experiment wrote only to /tmp/op6893-fs on the device, and the extraction path uses adb exec-out with no device-side staging file
source_recheck.conclusion: the source was not written by this work; it is a live snapshot that the vendor modem keeps updating, so the frozen copy is a point-in-time snapshot rather than a permanent mirror

baseline_build.purpose: prove the committed tree builds with the experimental modem options disabled
baseline_build.note: out/.config now holds the baseline configuration again, matching the earlier restore convention

operator_tooling.location: /data/src/mainline/mt6893-direct (not a git repository, so site-specific paths and the serial stay out of the kernel tree)
scripts: md-release-cycle.py: SysRq reset, wait for SSH, push the marked private working copy, the runner modules and optionally the audited policy
md-release-run.sh: on-device probe that pins SCP, powers the MD, runs the explicit runner with both opt-in traces and prints the state
md-rpc-policy.py: derives the private policy from the audited getprop export; reproduces the hardware-tested policy byte-identically (34 facts: 25 present, 9 proven absent)
md-nvram-extract.py: read-only adb exec-out tar into a new snapshot with marker and manifest; refuses unsafe members and never writes to the source
md-nvram-recheck.py: live-versus-snapshot comparison with device mtimes so a delta is attributed rather than assumed

not_claimed: that the modem reaches HS2 or radio readiness
that the current snapshot equals the live NVRAM at any later time

enabled_build.purpose: prove the committed tree builds with the experimental modem options enabled after the CCIF one-read fix
enabled_build.identity_note: the only later change is documentation, so this Image.gz is the artifact for the current code; a rebuild at the newer commit would differ in the identity string only

later_changes: drivers/misc/mediatek/ccci/ccci-ccif.c (only built when OP6893_CCCI_CCIF is enabled)
build_equivalence.conclusion: the recorded baseline artifact stays representative of the current tree because none of the later changes are compiled with the baseline configuration

previously_broken: test_modem_ccif_service_tx.py: model lacked the printk added by the deferred-send diagnostic, and the sender read the AP busy word twice
test_modem_scp_mmio_owner.py: still asserted that no RX start exists at all and still expected the owner structure inside the .c file
